title: Leverage
description:
S01 E03 — The Two Horse Job
The team travels to Kentucky to help a horse trainer who lost everything when the racehorses he trains were killed in a fire.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E05 — The Bank Shot Job
Nate, Sophie and the mark are taken hostage during a bank robbery; the team tries to help the two amateur and desperate robbers.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E04 — The Miracle Job
Nate helps his old friend Father Paul stop the demolition of his church. His means however, a fake miracle, are a lot less holy than his ends.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E06 — The Stork Job
The team goes after an adoption company that is scamming couples looking to adopt war orphans; the team hijacks the production of a horror movie.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E11 — The Juror No. 6 Job
One of Parker's aliases is chosen for jury duty; the team tries to stop someone from buying a favorable verdict in the trial.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E10 — The 12 Step Job
The team tricks an alcoholic financier into rehab to try to recover the money he swindled from a charity.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E12 — The First David Job
The team targets the CEO who denied Nate's son medical treatment.

title: Leverage
description:
S01 E13 — The Second David Job
Nate comes out of hiding and tries to get his team back together to directly challenge Sterling and Blackpoole.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E01 — The Beantown Bailout Job
Nate reassembles the team to pit the local Irish mob against a banker who is gaming a government bailout.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E02 — The Tap-Out Job
The crew tries to get a corrupt mixed martial arts promoter to invest in a fake cable television network.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E03 — The Order 23 Job
The team goes after a shady hedge-fund manager; the mark is in the custody of the U.S. Marshals and is being hunted by the Armenian mob.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E04 — The Fairy Godparents Job
A clinic is forced to close because its funds were lost in a Ponzi scheme; the team goes after a corrupt investment banker who has money hidden from the authorities.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E05 — The Three Days of the Hunter Job
A TV host claims a school-bus driver caused an accident that left two children dead; Sophie takes the lead as the team sets out to put the host in her place.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E06 — The Top Hat Job
The team tries to infiltrate a corporation responsible for putting tainted food on the market.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E07 — The Two Live Crew Job
The team must go up against a crew of thieves in order to retrieve a priceless artwork.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E08 — The Ice Man Job
Hardison acts as the inside man when the team goes after an unscrupulous diamond merchant.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E09 — The Lost Heir Job
The team tries to stop a corrupt lawyer from taking over his client's estate.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E10 — The Runway Job
The team infiltrates the fashion world to take down a sweatshop owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E11 — The Bottle Job
The team runs a high-tech version of a classic con in order to save a bar from a loan shark.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E12 — The Zanzibar Marketplace Job
The team has to work with Sterling to free Maggie from a Ukrainian jail.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E13 — The Future Job
A con man masquerades as a psychic medium in order to steal money from his clients.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E14 — The Three Strikes Job
The team runs into an unexpected complication while trying to take down a corrupt mayor.

title: Leverage
description:
S02 E15 — The Maltese Falcon Job
Surrounded by FBI and with Sterling hot on their heels, the team decides to hide in plain sight, while continuing to take down the corrupt mayor and his gunrunning partner; Nate has a different endgame in mind for them all.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E01 — The Jailhouse Job
In order to save the life of an innocent inmate, Nate must bring down the corrupt warden of the prison where he is incarcerated and escape.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E02 — The Reunion Job
The team infiltrates the high school reunion of a software magnate who is involved with the Axis of Evil.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E03 — The Inside Job
When Parker is trapped in an unknown location while working a theft for her mentor, the team must race the clock to find and free her.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E04 — The Scheherazade Job
In order to rob a Boston vault, the team must time their heist to a nearby symphony concert.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E05 — The Double Blind Job
Nate and the team try to take down a corrupt CEO before he can release a drug that will kill thousands.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E06 — The Studio Job
In order to take down a corrupt record executive, the team must infiltrate the world of country and western music.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E07 — The Gone Fishin' Job
After targeting a greedy debt collector, the crew discovers that their target is also a domestic terrorist who is funding an armed militia.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E08 — The Boost Job
The team enters the world of master car thieves in order to take down a crooked car dealer.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E09 — The Three-Card Monte Job
When small businessmen are blackmailed into committing crimes, the team's investigation reveals an unlikely foe.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E10 — The Underground Job
In the aftermath of a deadly mine explosion, the team infiltrates the coal mines of West Virginia to stop the dangerous practices of the mine's owner.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E11 — The Rashomon Job
The team realizes that they each tried to steal the same artifact on the same night five years ago.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E12 — The King George Job
The team discovers that an antiquities trafficker is using refugee children to smuggle artifacts; Sophie confronts the consequences of her past.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E13 — The Morning After Job
The team tries to get a violent hedge fund manager to reveal information that could lead to Damien Moreau.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E14 — The Ho, Ho, Ho Job
The team takes over a mall on Christmas Eve and uncovers a scheme perpetrated by an old nemesis; Eliot goes undercover as Santa Claus; Parker and Hardison are Santa's helpers.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E15 — The Big Bang Job
The team infiltrates a government research lab to stop Damien Moreau from auctioning information to international terrorists.

title: Leverage
description:
S03 E16 — The San Lorenzo Job
After following Moreau to San Lorenzo, the team discovers that he is the chief advisor to the current President.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E01 — The Long Way Down Job
The team must recover lost evidence from a mountain while battling hired guns and bad weather.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E02 — The 10 Li'l Grifters Job
When a mark is killed during a sting, the team races to complete the con and find the killer.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E03 — The 15 Minutes Job
The team attempts to take down a corrupt PR consultant by using his own methods against him.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E04 — The Van Gogh Job
While tracking a Van Gogh painting, the team learns the painting was the center of a World War II love story.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E05 — The Hot Potato Job
The team infiltrates a corrupt group involved in corporate agriculture to recover a stolen object.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E06 — The Carnival Job
While the team infiltrates a high-tech home to steal a computer chip, the family's child is abducted from a carnival.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E07 — The Grave Danger Job
The crew sets its sites on a funeral director who embezzles money from grieving patrons.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E08 — The Boiler Room Job
The team goes up against a con man from a long lineage of greats.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E09 — The Cross My Heart Job
The team tries to retrieve a stolen heart intended for a 15-year-old patient.

title: Leverage
description:
S04 E10 — The Queen's Gambit Job
Sterling convinces the team to steal a calibration weight for a nuclear reactor during an international chess tournament.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E10 — The Work-Study Job
After a college professor steals a discovery from his grad student, the Leverage team has to take him down while returning the credit and reputation to the young woman in the process.

title: Leverage: Redemption
description:
S02 E11 — The Belly of the Beast Job
The team reluctantly enlists the help of a naïve but ambitious assistant to take down a predatory music producer; told from the point of view of a regular person.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E03 — A Fisherfolk Tale
Alex befriends a boat mechanic wrongfully accused of murder in a remote fishing village; along with Kai and Ernesto, unravels an international smuggling operation.

title: Almost Paradise
description:
S02 E04 — Bahala Na
When Alex temporarily moves in with Ernesto, he is drawn into a family drama that transcends generations, spans decades, and proves that the past is never dead, it is not even past.

title: The Ark
description:
S02 E01 — Failed Experiment
The crew must decide the best way forward with or without help from their nemesis, Evelyn Maddox.

title: The Ark
description:
S02 E02 — Kill or Be Killed
The arrival of new crew members presents questions of who can be trusted and what to do with them.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E09 — And the Feast of the Vampire
While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

title: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
description:
S01 E10 — And Going Medieval
When Vikram attempts to return to 1847, via a homemade time machine, he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and Elaine.

When a formidable enemy steals the Maharaja's crown and traps the crew in the museum, they must find a way out and the crown before they go down for the crime.

description: A shy young man turns to his grandfather and his grandfather's old war buddies to help him rescue the woman of his dreams from kidnappers.

description:
S02 E04 — The Other You
Two theories on what could and shouldn't have been are revealed when two realities intertwine.

description:
S01 E11 — And the Graffiti of the Gods
Graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl; the team must figure out how these strange events relate to Gregor's Hammer and Gregor's imminent return.

description:
S01 E12 — And the Unfinished Business
General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia, gaining control of their nuclear arsenal; the team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.
